data_fields.name: wander_range
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 default; set per type by config code 26 (2-byte)

data_fields.name: wander_leash_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: 500 (test is greater than 500 on the old counter; comment says 501)

data_fields.name: patrol_points
data_fields.donor_constant: count as one byte; each point a signed 4-byte packed coord

data_fields.name: move_restrict
data_fields.donor_constant: NORMAL default; config code 206 (1 byte); NOMOVE stops wander

best_idea: Give each NPC type a short data route (ordered points, each with a dwell in ticks) plus a leash to its spawn tile, and run both as one idle step per server tick.
decision_why: Route-with-dwell and leash-to-spawn are NPC-type rows, which fits zones as data; the donor defects (dwell counted as stuck, unseeded Math.random, half-weighted end offsets) are fixed in the sketch; the snap-home is not kept as the only way back.
acceptance: A server test with a 3-point route and dwell 2 at point 2 shows the NPC standing on exactly 2 ticks (the arrival tick and the next) and walking on the third, with no snap during the dwell; a wander NPC stays inside its range box over 10,000 seeded ticks, and the same seed gives the same tiles.
